ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of approximately 45% high-intensity (white) to 55% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface area.

Right lobe features a dense cluster of circular white focal spots on a black field at the distal tip, transitioning to a larger white patch toward the mid-lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the outer edges of both lobes, sweeping upward and outward from the submerged central axis.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of at least three distinct, near-vertical dark linear pixel disruptions crossing the white pigmentation field on the interior region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular rosette scarring distributed across both lobes; visible irregular indentation/trauma on the trailing edge of the left lobe proximal to the submerged notch area.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'honeycomb' texture created by the high-density cluster of circular white-rimmed marks at the extreme lateral tip of the right lobe.
